name: Bloodtalon Matriarch

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you know Sen'jin Village's handlers prize raptors as agile companions and war mounts. The Bloodtalon line is valued for cunning and speed.
As a member of the Horde, you know that raising local predators as loyal allies helps protect the Darkspear settlement and strengthen the Horde's presence on the Durotar coast.
As a hunter, you know how hard it is to tame a seasoned adult beast. Raising a predator from birth can forge a true bond.

faq.answer: The Bloodtalon Matriarch is a fierce adult raptor whose pack is known for speed and cunning. Attempts to capture and train her failed as she grew too dangerous to handle. The Darkspear trolls seek to secure her eggs.

The Matriarch has become a danger to the surrounding territory, and adult raptors are difficult to tame. By quelling her and securing her clutch, handlers in Sen'jin Village can protect the tribe and preserve her bloodline.
faq.q: Why must the Bloodtalon Matriarch be dealt with?

faq.answer: Full-grown raptors have stubborn, violent instincts and are nearly impossible to tame. Handlers can raise the young from eggs as loyal companions instead.
faq.q: Why not tame the Matriarch instead?

faq.answer: The captured clutch is brought to Sen'jin Village to be incubated and raised. The trolls plan to train the young raptors from infancy as reliable allies and mounts for the tribe.
faq.q: What will happen to the Matriarch's offspring?

aliases: where is this quest handed in
faq.answer: The work centers near Sen'jin Village on the coast of Durotar. There, handlers seek to raise loyal raptors for the Darkspear tribe.
The Bloodtalon pack is prized for speed and cunning. Those traits make its young desirable as companions and mounts, while full-grown raptors resist taming.
faq.q: What makes the Bloodtalon pack special?

sections.body: Along Durotar's coast, Bloodtalon raptors are prized for speed and cunning. Handlers in Sen'jin Village value those traits in dependable mounts and companions for the Darkspear tribe. Yet full-grown raptors have stubborn, violent instincts. Once grown, wild adults are scarcely tamed.
sections.title: The Bloodtalon Lineage

sections.body: Repeated attempts to capture and train the Matriarch have only made her more aggressive. Now she threatens the surrounding territory. The trolls seek to protect their tribe and preserve her bloodline. They must quell the dangerous mother and save her clutch, so the next generation can be raised from the egg as loyal allies.
sections.title: Preserving the Bloodline

summary: Near Sen'jin Village, handlers face a threat from the Bloodtalon Matriarch as they seek her young. Her pack is prized for speed and cunning, but adults resist taming. The Darkspear seek to secure her clutch and raise loyal companions from the egg.
